Bulls Eye Overdrive The BigNoise Bulls Eye Overdrive is quite a Jekyll and Hyde affair. Goes from clean to mean, very useable all across the Gain knob. All the way CCW on Gain and it does a very cool clean boost with just a touch of hair when you dig in. Nudge the Gain up just a little and you are in instant Blesbreaker territory, crisp and dynamic. Further up and it roars like a hot rodded Marshall. All the way up she screams and sings in sustain, leaning into sweet amplike feedback with ease. The Tone knob is a classic from darker to brighter sound. The very clever Shape knob is an active mids eq, CCW it scoops for chunky tight riffage, CW it boosts the mids and adds warmth and cut through the mix. Where the guitar lives. The Fat control adds low mid range grind. NZ $ 199 including free courier shipping within NZ. For overseas orders please inquire about cost and shipping options. Equilibrium Boost and EQ The Equilibrium Boost is a great tone shaper and clean boost, another Swiss Army Knife in your tool box. Whether it’s like adding another channel to your amp or pushing the clean or dirt with an extra flavour. Bring it all in the right balance or push it over the edge, you choose. It is in many ways like a analog warm sounding equalizer to get the tones of classic amp and speaker combinations. NZ $ 189 including free courier shipping within NZ. For overseas orders please inquire about cost and shipping options. Tres Hombres Overdrive Great for pushing and already at the egde of breakup, gringing tubeamp into oblivion! Tex Mex sauce, the Grit and Gravel control add different clipping textures and dirt in both the CCW and CW position, bringing it into Fuzz territory. Great cleanup with volume pot on guitar for lots of shades of drive at the fingertips. The Fat control adds low mid range grind. NZ $ 199 including free courier shipping within NZ. For overseas orders please inquire about cost and shipping options. Spitfire Overdrive The circuit architecture of a three tube stage real amp translated into a stomp box, with two adjustable gain stages and a very useful treble and bass tone stack. Yeah. Allows for a lot of different drive textures depending where pre gain and gain are set. From low gain articulation to fat saturated distortion, it’s all here. NZ $ 199 including free courier shipping within NZ. For overseas orders please inquire about cost and shipping options. “I’ve got a couple of BigNoise drives (Princeton and Screwdriver) and both of them are extremely well built. The sound is bang on the money and these will be getting used for a long time!
